acceptance_criteria: Fixture tests pass

items.title: Implement accessible form discovery
items.description: Convert Playwright DOM observations into validated FormField records.
items.expected_impact: Reliable adapter-independent field mapping
acceptance_criteria: All field types covered
Controlled fixture extraction passes

items.title: Add API authentication and authorization
items.description: Protect personal profile, review actions, artifacts, and administrative endpoints.
items.expected_impact: Prevents unauthorized access to employment data
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized requests rejected
Scopes tested
Secrets remain external

items.title: Implement HeadHunter public vacancy connector
items.description: Extract hh.ru vacancies through the official HTTPS JSON API without submission.
items.expected_impact: Russian-market vacancy ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Strict URL tests pass
Official API fixture passes
Read-only live smoke passes

items.title: Implement policy-safe LinkedIn connector boundary
items.description: Canonicalize user-provided job references without scraping; reserve partner API integration for approved credentials.
items.expected_impact: LinkedIn tracking without policy violations
acceptance_criteria: Lookalike URLs rejected
No network request to LinkedIn
Manual import persists provenance

items.title: Add Redis worker leases and domain rate limits
items.description: Prevent duplicate concurrent application work and enforce conservative per-domain limits.
items.expected_impact: Safe multi-worker execution
acceptance_criteria: Lease recovery tested
Duplicate workers blocked
Rate limits measured

items.title: Add bounded versioned selector recovery
items.description: Try deterministic semantic alternatives after selector failure and persist reversible proven mappings.
items.expected_impact: Recover controlled form redesigns without unbounded retries
acceptance_criteria: Recovery attempts are bounded
Successful fallback is versioned
Redesign regression fixture passes

items.title: Route durable tasks to the isolated Chromium worker
items.description: Persist typed browser task payloads, isolate queue claims, and stop controlled execution at a screenshot-backed review boundary.
items.expected_impact: Restart-safe background browser execution without arbitrary external navigation
acceptance_criteria: Dispatcher cannot claim browser tasks
Browser worker claims through PostgreSQL
Controlled Compose smoke reaches waiting_for_user
Evidence records submission=false

items.title: Connect Greenhouse review preparation to the durable browser queue
items.description: Route an explicitly confirmed reviewed application to Chromium using only persisted inputs and stop before submission.
items.expected_impact: Usable API and web path from reviewed Greenhouse vacancy to screenshot-backed form preparation
acceptance_criteria: Required answers and managed CV are validated
Task payload cannot inject a URL
Redirects leave trusted hosts only by failing
Review UI labels the no-submit action
Compose boundary smoke passes

items.title: Real hh.ru response submission via user-captured browser session
items.description: Opt-in (APP_ENABLE_HEADHUNTER_APPLY) browser automation that submits a real hh.ru response using a session the user captures by hand (scripts/browser_login_capture.py). No password is ever typed by the automation; CAPTCHA/verification checkpoints pause at waiting_for_user with a screenshot.
items.expected_impact: First real (irreversible) submission workflow, opt-in and scoped to hh.ru only
acceptance_criteria: Off by default
No credentials stored
CAPTCHA routes to waiting_for_user with screenshot
Resume field does not block scheduling (hh.ru selects it natively)
Unit tests cover flag-gating and missing-session routing

items.title: Real LinkedIn Easy Apply submission via user-captured browser session
items.description: Opt-in (APP_ENABLE_LINKEDIN_APPLY) browser automation of the native Easy Apply modal only; external-redirect jobs are not attempted. Same session-capture and CAPTCHA-checkpoint model as HH-BROWSER-001. Automates against LinkedIn's explicit terms at the user's informed request.
items.expected_impact: Real submission workflow for LinkedIn Easy Apply jobs, opt-in and risk-flagged
acceptance_criteria: Off by default
No credentials stored
External-redirect jobs fail closed instead of following an unknown host
CAPTCHA routes to waiting_for_user with screenshot
Unit tests cover flag-gating and missing-session routing

items.title: Wire a real model provider into app/llm for cover letters and screening answers
items.description: Implement a ModelProvider (Anthropic Messages API, user-supplied API key) behind app/llm/router.py, and a materials-generation service/endpoint that drafts cover_letter_text and free-text screening answers from verified profile facts only, leaving them in awaiting_review for human edit/approval before any submission.
items.expected_impact: Removes the main manual step (typing every cover letter) blocking real end-to-end usage
acceptance_criteria: Provider never invents facts not present in verified profile facts
Generated text is written to awaiting_review materials, never auto-submitted
Cost/timeout budget enforced via ModelRequest
Unit tests cover provider failure and budget-exceeded fallthrough

items.title: Criteria-based vacancy discovery for hh.ru
items.description: Browser-based (not api.hh.ru) search against hh.ru's public pages via adapters/job_boards/headhunter_browser.py, auto-creating vacancies and applications in awaiting_review. Exposed as POST /v1/users/{id}/discover-headhunter-vacancies and the one-click /dashboard UI (resume upload -> confirmed skills -> locations -> search).
items.expected_impact: Removes manual per-vacancy import step
acceptance_criteria: Dedupe against existing vacancies by source_url
Respects a configurable per-run result cap
No auto-scheduling of apply tasks without human review

items.title: Replace api.hh.ru with browser-based search/extraction
items.description: api.hh.ru's anonymous access is CAPTCHA-limited in practice. HeadHunterBrowserAdapter.search()/extract_vacancy() now read hh.ru's public search-results and vacancy pages directly through Chromium instead, with no session required (only the separate apply step needs one). Both POST /v1/vacancies/import-headhunter and POST /v1/users/{id}/discover-headhunter-vacancies use the browser adapter exclusively; adapters/job_boards/headhunter_api.py (the HTTP client) is kept but no longer called from the API layer.
items.expected_impact: Vacancy discovery actually works where the anonymous API was blocked
acceptance_criteria: No api.hh.ru calls in the discovery/import path
Search works without a captured session; only apply needs one
CAPTCHA during search degrades to an empty result, not a hard failure
Unit tests cover area-id resolution, href parsing, and discovery staging with a fake adapter

items.title: Browser-based LinkedIn job search and vacancy extraction
items.description: LinkedInBrowserAdapter.search()/extract_vacancy() added alongside the existing Easy Apply automation, gated behind APP_ENABLE_LINKEDIN_APPLY and a session captured via scripts/browser_login_capture.py linkedin (LinkedIn search is not usable anonymously, unlike hh.ru). Exposed as POST /v1/users/{id}/discover-linkedin-vacancies. Jobs without native Easy Apply are skipped during staging rather than followed to an external site. Not yet wired into the /dashboard UI (hh.ru only so far).
items.expected_impact: LinkedIn vacancies can be discovered the same way hh.ru ones are
acceptance_criteria: Off by default (same flag as apply)
No credentials stored; requires a hand-captured session
Non-Easy-Apply jobs are not staged
Wire into /dashboard UI (not yet done)

items.title: Personal dashboard: resume -> confirmed skills -> locations -> search -> accept
items.description: app/static/dashboard.html served at GET /dashboard. Upload resume (PDF/DOCX) -> LLM drafts skills/summary/keywords (extract-profile) -> human confirms (confirm-profile-facts, the only thing that becomes a verified, usable fact) -> pick locations or 'anywhere' -> one click searches hh.ru and auto-drafts cover letters -> each result shows match score, editable cover letter, a link to the vacancy, and an Accept button that calls apply-headhunter (falls back to the manual link if that's disabled/unavailable).
items.expected_impact: One click from resume to a reviewable, scored shortlist with drafted cover letters
acceptance_criteria: Resume analysis never auto-saves; requires explicit human confirmation
Search only ever creates awaiting_review applications, never submits
Accept button uses the real apply-headhunter endpoint with explicit confirmation
LinkedIn not yet integrated into this UI

items.title: Use structured vacancy skills in Matching v2
items.description: Build a versioned matching source from description, required skills, and preferred skills, with alias-aware deduplication.
items.expected_impact: Matching explanations and scores cover the same key skills shown in the UI
acceptance_criteria: Every structured skill has a requirement
Changing structured skills changes the matching content version
Aliases do not create duplicate requirements

items.title: Expose explicit key-skill evaluation coverage
items.description: Record whether every vacancy key skill was evaluated and distinguish match, insufficient evidence, evaluation error, missing, and not evaluated states.
items.expected_impact: Explanations cannot silently omit key skills
acceptance_criteria: Coverage is persisted in explanation JSON
Dashboard renders every key skill and state
Regression test rejects silent omissions

items.title: Make Direct to reranker a server-side search mode
items.description: When selected, ingest owner-scoped RAG context, schedule detailed matching with a forced refresh, wait for completion, and emit results ordered by the calculated score.
items.expected_impact: Search results are shown after available RAG and reranker processing rather than reranked by a later UI click
acceptance_criteria: Flag is sent to the server
RAG ingestion precedes matching scheduling
External reranker is used when configured
Unavailable external services preserve local fallback results

items.title: Add safe diagnostics and retry for evaluation errors
items.description: Persist non-sensitive evaluator failure codes and expose a bounded user-triggered retry without treating technical errors as missing skills.
items.expected_impact: Users can distinguish and recover from technical evaluation failures
acceptance_criteria: Failure codes contain no provider response bodies
Retry is bounded and explicit
Technical failures do not become missing skills

items.title: Backfill stale matching explanations
items.description: Provide a bounded owner-scoped operation to recalculate existing results created before the versioned structured-skill source.
items.expected_impact: Existing saved vacancies receive current explanations without manual per-card work
acceptance_criteria: Only owner-scoped applications are scheduled
Progress and failures are visible
Previous results remain available until replacement succeeds

items.title: Complete cross-user endpoint audit
items.description: Verify ownership enforcement and negative tests for every user-owned API, artifact, browser, matching, email, and RAG path.
items.expected_impact: Closes remaining tenant-isolation uncertainty
acceptance_criteria: Every user-owned endpoint has a negative cross-user test
Artifacts and background jobs enforce ownership
Audit results update SEC-001 status

items.title: Restore green static quality gates
items.description: Separate mechanical formatting from behavioral fixes, then resolve Ruff and mypy failures without weakening checks.
items.expected_impact: New regressions are visible instead of hidden by existing failures
acceptance_criteria: Ruff check passes
Ruff format check passes
Mypy passes
Full pytest remains green

items.title: Calibrate Matching v2 on reviewed evaluation data
items.description: Measure required-skill coverage, ranking quality, confidence calibration, and error slices before promoting matching beyond shadow mode.
items.expected_impact: Evidence-based score and rollout decisions
acceptance_criteria: Human-reviewed production-like fixtures exist
Quality thresholds and slices are reported
Rollback criteria are documented

items.title: Provision and authorize the JSA RAG collections
items.description: Create and authorize the profiles, resumes, and vacancies collections in the selected RAG project, then verify owner-scoped access with the JSA service key.
items.expected_impact: Makes the collection contract usable by the running application and exposes resume documents in RAG administration.
acceptance_criteria: All three collections exist in the configured RAG project
The JSA service key can ingest and search each collection
Cross-owner reads are rejected
No private document content is written to logs

items.title: Synchronize analysed resumes with RAG
items.description: Ingest the selected resume into the resumes collection after successful analysis, refresh it when the analysed fields change, and let the operator retry synchronization manually.
items.expected_impact: Resume documents appear without requiring a Direct to reranker search first.
acceptance_criteria: Successful resume analysis schedules owner-scoped ingestion
Retries are bounded and idempotent
RAG failure does not lose the authoritative resume record
Synchronization status is visible to the operator
An operator can manually retry a reviewed resume without re-uploading it

items.title: Synchronize reviewed profile facts with RAG
items.description: Refresh the profiles collection after confirmed fact creation, update, import, or deletion while excluding unverified facts.
items.expected_impact: RAG profile context stays aligned with facts approved by the user.
acceptance_criteria: Only verified facts are ingested
Every supported fact mutation triggers an idempotent refresh
Deleted facts disappear after synchronization
RAG failure does not block the authoritative profile update

items.title: Backfill existing profiles, resumes, and vacancies into RAG
items.description: Provide a bounded owner-scoped operation that populates the canonical collections from existing PostgreSQL records.
items.expected_impact: Existing users receive complete RAG coverage without manually re-uploading data.
acceptance_criteria: Backfill is owner-scoped and resumable
Progress, skipped records, and sanitized failures are reported
Repeated runs do not create duplicate logical documents
Batch size and retry count are bounded

items.title: Propagate resume and profile deletion to RAG
items.description: Add explicit owner-scoped deletion support so removed source records do not leave stale RAG documents.
items.expected_impact: Reduces stale search context and supports expected personal-data lifecycle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Deleting a resume removes its logical RAG document
Deleting the last profile fact refreshes or removes the profile document
Deletion retries are idempotent and owner-scoped
Failures are visible without exposing document content

items.title: Add a real RAG integration smoke test
items.description: Exercise collection discovery, owner-scoped ingestion, indexing, search, and cleanup against the configured local RAG service.
items.expected_impact: Confirms that unit-tested contracts work across the actual service boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Smoke test uses synthetic content only
Profile, resume, and vacancy round trips pass
Cross-owner isolation is verified
Synthetic documents are cleaned up
